creative_direction: Show Kazuha Toyama with her recognizable high ponytail and ribbon, dressed in a modest cream blouse with a soft green collar. She makes a small open-hand greeting near the lower side of the portrait, keeping all fingers clear of the face. Her expression is bright and natural, with both eyes open and visible. Use clean cel shading, simple apricot background planes, and a few broad shadow shapes under the hair and collar. Keep her teenage proportions and everyday styling. The ribbon stays inside the safe crop, and the pose is compact rather than energetic or theatrical. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
